title: The Convention Opens
description: The Constitutional Convention holds its first public session today at the Parliament Great Hall. Every faction in Veltrian politics has sent representatives. Professor Theron has the floor. Whatever happens this morning sets the tone for everything that follows.

title: Review the Constitutional Draft
description: The constitutional text is in working sessions. This is the time to examine the draft provisions, consider the tradeoffs, and mark the document before it moves to final committee. Some provisions can still be adjusted.

title: Budget Allocation — Convention Quarter
description: The convention will consume political capital and treasury resources. Vostane wants to establish the fiscal baseline before the delegates start making promises the budget can't keep.

title: Delegate Reception — Cross-Faction Outreach
description: The convention delegates are gathering in informal settings every evening. Vyktor recommends attending the Workers' Coalition reception. Maric says the Halvekist delegates are surprisingly approachable after a drink. Every vote will count.
